one_line: The paper proposes and validates an ISO 50001-based energy management maturity model by self-assessment questionnaires in ISO 50001 certified organizations across mixed industrial sectors and in ISO 50001 non-certified food and non-metallic mineral products factories in Serbia and the region; steel and cement appear only as literature citations, not as the demonstrated context.
